insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident only; treatment taken outside India not covered
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Standard IRDAI Saral Suraksha Bima (personal accident) product; waiting periods limited to optional hospitalization expenses section.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Optional cover (Section 3.2(b)) — Hospitalisation expenses due to Accident, up to 10% of base sum insured
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Only payable on accident-related hospitalization; AYUSH covered without sub-limits; road ambulance up to Rs.2,000 per hospitalization

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care treatments covered under the optional hospitalization expenses cover
day_care_treatments.notes: Within the 10% of base SI cap

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Domiciliary hospitalization and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Covered without any sub-limits under hospitalization-due-to-accident cover
ayush_coverage.notes: Within the 10% of base SI optional hospitalization cap

copayment_trigger_notes: No mandatory co-payment under Saral Suraksha Bima base cover

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Treatment taken outside the geographical limits of India is excluded

permanent_exclusions: intentional self-injury, suicide or attempted suicide
under influence of intoxicating liquor, drugs or other intoxicants
aviation/ballooning other than as a fare-paying passenger in scheduled airlines
breach of law with criminal intent
war, invasion, civil war, rebellion, mutiny, military or usurped power
nuclear, chemical or biological terrorism and ionizing radiation
professional hazardous or adventure sports (mountaineering, scuba diving, sky diving, etc.)
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI personal accident exclusions: no cover for self-inflicted injury, intoxication, professional adventure sports, war/nuclear risks, treatment outside India, and OPD/domiciliary care. The hospitalization-expenses optional cover is restricted to accident-related admissions only.
claim_process_summary: Standard IRDAI Saral Suraksha Bima claim process — intimate insurer/TPA, submit claim form with treating physician's certificate and hospital documents; cashless via network hospitals, reimbursement otherwise.
